scope: Actual production MapDataPage callbacks/effects in the hook replay adapter; synthetic deferred provider replies and controlled clock. Not browser/native evidence.

results.id: cache restoration keeps the typed keyword and refreshes the restored page with it
name selection survives tab cache restoration and refreshes with the name and restored page
Dispatch selection resets on tab change while the cached page and rows are restored
selection is retained across row refresh (connection change) and search while rows are replaced
rapid navigation with deferred replies settles on the final tab only
Normal/Scheduled transitions: counts, list loading on entry, change events and normal state untouched
the page clock drives Scheduled Plunder once per second from the controlled clock
fence: without a provider every job/schedule/share control stays disabled and calls nothing
schedule success: busy, selection cleared, list reloaded, navigation to Scheduled Plunder; failure keeps selection
truck schedule success clears only the Truck selection
share: label flips while sharing, only shared uuids leave the selection, partial/success messages
Scheduled actions: busy keys, ghost cancel identity, reload, error message and fences
clear-data empties both the Dispatch/Ghost and the Truck selection (original tr: on({}), cn({}))
a selected Resource name that the refreshed options no longer offer is cleared
